response.sql:
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage_pct,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescopes
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusage_pct,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.telescope_count / a.avg_telescopes AS telescope_count_ratio
FROM station_stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_count a
ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count per station is taken over stations that have at least one telescope, since the calculation groups the telescopes table; observatories with no telescopes are excluded from the denominator.
AVG(bandusagepct) skips NULL values, so missing bandwidth readings are ignored, while COUNT(*) counts every telescope at the station, including those with a NULL bandwidth value.

alternatives.interpretation: The average telescope count per station is taken over all observatories, including those with zero telescopes, so stations without telescopes lower the average.

WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT o.observstation,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage_pct,
         COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescopes
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusage_pct,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.telescope_count / a.avg_telescopes AS telescope_count_ratio
FROM station_stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_count a
ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
